shots: The young woman in a faded pink striped cotton dress, seen from behind and the side, standing in the sunlit garden of a whitewashed farmhouse with a reed roof and a tall draw well, holding up a freshly picked bunch from the beds; she snaps one stem off with a crisp sound as she picks; sunflowers and mallows around her, the wide flat plain, sunflower fields and grazing horses behind, summer sunshine.

Walking-height view over a sunflower field facing the sun; the flowers and grass lean gently in the wind, trees at the far edge, a few insects drifting.
Close-up of the same horse's head, mane lifting in the wind, soft snort, lit from the side, its small natural sounds clearly heard.
A horse grazing by the fence beside the house at a whitewashed farmhouse with a reed roof and a tall draw well, bright leaves swaying in front of the lens.

The garden path of a whitewashed farmhouse with a reed roof and a tall draw well: a green arch of climbing plants over a gravel path, vegetable beds and sunflowers and mallows on both sides, leaves stirring in the breeze.
Top-down view of a basket of peppers, tomatoes, apricots and corn on sunlit grass among clover; the horse wanders into frame and sniffs at it, sunlight and leaf shadows over the food.

A huge orange sunset over the plain seen through trees above the roof of a whitewashed farmhouse with a reed roof and a tall draw well; leaves move slightly, birds cross the sky, the camera is held still.
